question:
You will be shown several images captured during a robotic manipulation task.
Each image comes with a description of the camera position from which it was taken.
Please use this information to help answer the following question.


Image 1 (ego_left): A left arm-mounted camera provides this first-person perspective of the task.


Image 2 (fix_center): This perspective shows the manipulation task from the center of the camera setup.


Image 3 (ego_right): A right arm-mounted camera provides this first-person perspective of the task.


The following images represent different perspectives of the same robotic manipulation task.
One image was captured at a different temporal point than the others.
Consider factors like object positions, robot configurations, lighting conditions, and scene composition.
Which image number displays temporal misalignment with the rest?
